messages:
Lina: @channel Quick sync — Kaldera (partner) is ready to onboard eu-west-3. They want a marketplace listing + KMS integration. Initial capacity ask: 4 GPUs (A100-class) with burst to 8 for the first month. Also want a joint announcement. Timeline goal: soft-launch in ~3 weeks. Need quota approvals, legal + security signoff, and marketplace entitlements. Tagging folks: @Ana (partnerships ops), @Mike (legal), @Satoshi (infra), @Alice (security).

Tom (Kaldera): Hi all — confirming the numbers. Expected QPS ~120 req/s at p95 latency target 250ms. We'll start with 4 gpus and scale if needed. We can share announcement draft next week.

Ana: Thanks. Can you confirm exact SKU names and whether you need dedicated pool (Dedicated) or hosted? Also clarify billing model for marketplace listing.

Tom (Kaldera): Dedicated pool preferred for isolation. SKUs: a100-40gb (or compatible). We'll commit to 3-month reserved for launch. Billing via marketplace contract.

Satoshi: Noted. Infra questions: do you need private VPC peering or mutual TLS only? And any HSM/KMS requirements? If Dedicated, we need an entitlement ticket to provision a nodepool.

Tom (Kaldera): We need VPC peering + KMS via customer-managed keys (HSM optional).

Alice: On security side, we'll need an initial data flow diagram and SSO requirements. Also request for SOC2 attestation and encryption-in-transit confirmation.

Mike: Legal — we'll need the marketplace contract draft and confirmation about data residency obligations (e.g., no cross-border backups). Also any marketing copy using Redwood joint logo needs approval.

Lina: Summary action items so far: 1) Ana to open entitlement/quota request with cloud partner and ops. 2) Satoshi to create provisioning checklist for Dedicated pool. 3) Alice to list docs needed for security review. 4) Mike to start marketplace contract review. 5) Tom to share announcement draft by next Tue. Target soft-launch date: 3 weeks from today (provisional).

Ana: I'll open quota ticket now. Quota request payload (will paste to cloud portal):
```
region: eu-west-3
resource: GPUs
sku: a100-40gb
initial_quota: 4
burst_quota: 8
purpose: Kaldera marketplace launch (dedicated)
owner: partnerships@redwood.com
```
I'll tag infra and cloud-partner team.

MarketplaceBot: New marketplace submission created: kaldera-euw3-submission-1755554321. Status: pending quotas.

Satoshi: For provisioning checklist — estimated lead time for Dedicated nodepool in eu-west-3 is 10 business days after quota approval. Will require kernel images and optimized inference runtime build (I'll queue a build). Also note that quantized model artifacts may need specific libcudnn versions.

Lina: Good to know. Ana — please escalate quota to partner channel if we don't get response in 48h.

Ana: Will do. Ticket opened: Q-98762. Escalation notes added.

Tom (Kaldera): Thanks — we'll prep the announcement draft and security docs. One question: can Redwood co-host the announcement on product blog?

Mike: Yes, but legal needs to sign off on joint messaging. Please include marketing-safe boilerplate; no forward-looking promises.

Alice: Also share expected data retention window and any PII flows. We'll fast-track on receipt.

Satoshi: I'll start the runtime build today. ETA: 5 working days for initial image.

Lina: Great. I'll consolidate this thread into an onboarding checklist doc and ping again once quotas are approved. If anyone has blockers, drop them here. :thumbsup:

Tom (Kaldera): Appreciated — ping me if you need any forms filled.

Ana: Update: partner cloud responded — preliminary quota approval pending a billing account link. I've requested the billing account ID. If they provide it today, we should hit the 48h window.

Lina: Perfect. Next sync if needed on Friday. Thanks everyone.
